name: ace-vscode
description: Keeps the Ace desktop app in step with the project open in VS Code: file tree, the file being edited, every edit, saves and git changes.

ace.host.description: Where the Ace app listens. Leave as is when Ace runs on this computer.

ace.port.description: The port the Ace app listens on for VS Code (Settings → Code in Ace).

ace.autoConnect.description: Connect to Ace when VS Code starts and keep retrying while Ace is not running.

ace.showStatusBar.description: Show the Ace item in the status bar. When off, the extension still works; use the Ace: Connect / Disconnect commands.

ace.maxFileKB.description: Files bigger than this are listed but their text is never sent.

ace.exclude.description: Glob patterns of files that are never sent to Ace.
